intent: AMD X3D V-cache mode is cache on every boot and driver rebind, so the scheduler prefers the V-cache CCD for games.
scope: Non-goal: CPU pinning of background jobs (already done)
changes: udev rule matching DRIVER amd_x3d_vcache on add and bind, no device name
Installer with install, --remove and --status, same pattern as fix_webcam_c270.sh

verification.evidence: red while the script was missing; 8 ok after
amd_x3d_mode frequency -> cache; prefcore ranking CPUs 0-5,12-17 now 196-216 vs 6-11,18-23 166-191 (before 166-191 vs 196-216); unbind/bind keeps cache
installs the rule, udevadm verify clean; no X3D device in vmbox so the mode itself is host-only

risks: Games on the V-cache CCD may boost lower than on the frequency CCD
Background load spills onto the V-cache CCD if the pinning is lifted
rollback: fixes/fix_amd_x3d_vcache.sh --remove, then write frequency to amd_x3d_mode or reboot
